_about: L-R2-1 NULL-guard sweep dispositions (tools/s4/null_guard_sweep.py). One entry per (function, key path) the sweep saw accepted with the key absent, null or empty. Verdicts: must_refuse (a defect; the check fails while it is still accepted), optional (a documented default or an optional field), fail_closed (accepted, but the result is a hold, FAIL or reject later), limitation (accepted for now, listed for Owner review). Synthetic data only; no values. DRAFT until the Owner confirms.
